title.account_switch_link: Your code to add this account

otp.chatBody: {{title}}: {{code}} This code is valid for 5 minutes and do not share it with anyone.
otp.smsBody:
{{title}}: {{code}}
This code is valid for 5 minutes.

botLink.askContact: To receive your code here, confirm this number belongs to you by sharing your contact with the button below.
botLink.senderMismatch: That contact belongs to someone else, so it cannot confirm this account. Use the button below to share your own number.
botLink.phoneMismatch: This number is not the one the code was requested for. Start again on the site with the number you are signing in with.
botLink.expired: This link has expired. Request the code again on the site to get a new one.
botLink.takenByAnotherAccount: This messenger account is already linked to a different account.
botLink.noAccount: No account is registered with this number.
botLink.linked: Your number is confirmed. Your code is on its way.
botLink.linkedNoCode: Your number is confirmed. You can request your code now.
botLink.unknownCommand: Open the link from the site to connect this messenger to your account.

otp.emailBody:
{{title}}: {{code}}

This code is valid for 5 minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email.

payment.credited: ✅ Your payment was confirmed and {{amount}} was added to your wallet. Reference: {{reference}}
payment.reversed: ↩️ Your payment of {{amount}} was reversed by the gateway and was not added to your wallet. The bank is returning it to your card; if it has not arrived within 72 hours, contact support.
payment.creditedMany: ✅ {{count}} of your payments were confirmed and added to your wallet.
payment.reversedMany: ↩️ {{count}} of your payments were reversed by the gateway and were not added to your wallet. The bank is returning them to your card.

subscription.paymentDue: ⚠️ Your subscription renewal of {{amount}} could not be charged: your billing balance is {{balance}}. Top up before {{suspendsAt}} or your panel will be suspended.
subscription.suspended: ⛔ Your panel was suspended because the subscription renewal of {{amount}} was not paid. Nothing was deleted: top up your billing balance and it is charged and reactivated at once.
subscription.paymentDueMany: ⚠️ {{count}} subscription renewals could not be charged. Top up your billing balance or your panel will be suspended.
subscription.suspendedMany: ⛔ Your panel was suspended {{count}} times for unpaid renewals. Nothing was deleted: top up your billing balance and it is reactivated at once.

panel.accepted: ✅ Your panel {{panel}} passed its connection test and was accepted.
panel.refused: ❌ Your panel {{panel}} was refused: its connection test showed it cannot report what the platform needs. The details are on the systems page.
panel.acceptedMany: ✅ {{count}} of your panels passed their connection test and were accepted.
panel.refusedMany: ❌ {{count}} of your panels were refused by their connection test. The details are on the systems page.

purchase.delivered: ✅ Your purchase is ready to use. You will find it under My services.
purchase.refunded: ↩️ Your purchase could not be delivered, so it was cancelled and {{amount}} was returned to your wallet.
purchase.deliveredMany: ✅ {{count}} of your purchases are ready to use. You will find them under My services.
purchase.refundedMany: ↩️ {{count}} of your purchases could not be delivered, so they were cancelled and their full price was returned to your wallet.
purchase.delayed: ⏳ Your purchase is paid and your service is still being prepared — this is taking a little longer than usual. You will get a message the moment it is ready; if it cannot be delivered, the full price goes back to your wallet.
purchase.delayedMany: ⏳ {{count}} of your purchases are paid and still being prepared. You will get a message the moment each one is ready.
purchase.stuckPanelUnavailableTitle: A purchase is waiting for a panel
purchase.stuckPanelUnavailable: ⚠️ A paid purchase has waited over 5 minutes for its service: {{panels}} panel(s) of its group cannot take a new user — not accepted or down, no inbound selected for sale, or full. Check the systems page; it is refunded if not delivered within the hour.
purchase.stuckPanelUnavailableMany: ⚠️ {{count}} paid purchases have waited over 5 minutes because panels of their groups cannot take a new user. Check the systems page.
purchase.stuckWriteUnconfirmedTitle: A purchase is not confirmed by its panels
purchase.stuckWriteUnconfirmed: ⚠️ A paid purchase has waited over 5 minutes for its service: its config was sent to the panels, but too few have confirmed it — a write the panel refused, or a panel not answering. Check the systems page; it is refunded if not delivered within the hour.
purchase.stuckWriteUnconfirmedMany: ⚠️ {{count}} paid purchases have waited over 5 minutes because their panels have not confirmed their configs. Check the systems page.
purchase.stuckStrategyNotBuiltTitle: A purchase's panel group cannot deliver
purchase.stuckStrategyNotBuilt: ⚠️ A paid purchase has waited over 5 minutes for its service: its panel group is set to a strategy that cannot deliver yet. Set the group back to mirror; it is refunded if not delivered within the hour.
purchase.stuckStrategyNotBuiltMany: ⚠️ {{count}} paid purchases have waited over 5 minutes because their panel group is set to a strategy that cannot deliver yet. Set it back to mirror.

retention.notConnected: 👋 Your service is ready but has not been used yet. To connect: open My services, copy the subscription link (or scan its QR code), add it to your VPN app — v2rayNG, Hiddify or Streisand — and connect.
retention.notConnectedMany: 👋 {{count}} of your services are ready but have not been used yet. Open My services, copy each subscription link (or scan its QR code), add it to your VPN app and connect.
retention.stillNotConnected: 🤔 Your service still has not been used, three days after it was ready. Copy the subscription link again from My services and import it into your VPN app. If it still does not connect, support will help you.
retention.stillNotConnectedMany: 🤔 {{count}} of your services still have not been used, three days after they were ready. Copy their links again from My services; if they still do not connect, support will help you.
retention.usageThreshold: 📊 You have used {{percent}}% of your service's volume; {{remaining}} is left. To keep it running without a break, renew it from My services.
retention.usageThresholdMany: 📊 {{count}} of your services are running low on volume. Check what is left in My services and renew them to keep them running.
retention.endsSoon: ⏳ Your service ends in {{days}} days. To keep it running without a break, renew it from My services.
retention.endsSoonMany: ⏳ {{count}} of your services end within a week. See when each one ends in My services and renew them to keep them running.
retention.endsWithinADayTitle: Your service ends within a day
retention.endsWithinADay: ⏰ Your service ends within a day. Renew it now from My services so it does not stop.
retention.endsWithinADayMany: ⏰ {{count}} of your services end within a day. Renew them now from My services so they do not stop.
retention.usageAndEndsSoon: 📊 You have used {{percent}}% of your service's volume ({{remaining}} left), and it ends in {{days}} days. To keep it running without a break, renew it from My services.
retention.usageAndEndsSoonMany: 📊 {{count}} of your services are running low on volume and ending soon. See each one in My services and renew them to keep them running.
retention.usageAndEndsSoonManyTitle: {{count}} services running low and ending soon
retention.usageAndEndsWithinADay: ⏰ You have used {{percent}}% of your service's volume ({{remaining}} left), and it ends within a day. Renew it now from My services so it does not stop.
retention.usageAndEndsWithinADayMany: ⏰ {{count}} of your services are running low on volume and end within a day. Renew them now from My services so they do not stop.
retention.usageAndEndsWithinADayManyTitle: {{count}} services running low and ending within a day
retention.ended: ⛔ Your service's time has run out and it has stopped. Renew it from My services to turn it back on — its link stays the same.
retention.endedMany: ⛔ {{count}} of your services have run out of time and stopped. Renew them from My services to turn them back on — their links stay the same.
retention.volumeSpentTitle: Your service's volume is used up
retention.volumeSpent: ⛔ Your service's volume is used up and it has stopped. Renew it from My services to turn it back on — its link stays the same.
retention.volumeSpentMany: ⛔ {{count}} of your services have used up their volume and stopped. Renew them from My services to turn them back on — their links stay the same.
retention.walletSpent: ⛔ Your service used up what your wallet could buy and has stopped. Top up your wallet and it turns back on by itself — its link stays the same.
retention.walletSpentMany: ⛔ {{count}} of your services used up what your wallet could buy and have stopped. Top up your wallet and they turn back on by themselves.
retention.capReachedTitle: Your service reached its spending cap
retention.capReached: ⛔ Your service reached the spending cap you set for it and has stopped — your wallet still has money. Raise or remove the cap in My services and it turns back on by itself — its link stays the same.
retention.capReachedMany: ⛔ {{count}} of your services reached the spending caps you set and have stopped — your wallet still has money. Raise or remove their caps in My services and they turn back on by themselves.
retention.capReachedManyTitle: {{count}} services stopped at their spending cap
retention.walletLow: 💳 Your wallet now buys only about {{remaining}} more of your service's traffic. Top up your wallet so it keeps running without a break.
retention.walletLowMany: 💳 Your wallet is running low for {{count}} of your services. Top up your wallet so they keep running without a break.
retention.purgeSoonTitle: Your service's config is removed within a day
retention.purgeSoon: 🗑️ Your stopped service will be removed from the server within a day. Renew it from My services before then to keep its config as it is — after that, a config you added by hand has to be added again.
retention.purgeSoonMany: 🗑️ {{count}} of your stopped services will be removed from the server within a day. Renew them from My services before then to keep their configs as they are.
retention.purgeSoonTopUp: 🗑️ Your stopped service will be removed from the server within a day. Top up your wallet before then to keep its config as it is — after that, a config you added by hand has to be added again.
retention.purgeSoonTopUpMany: 🗑️ {{count}} of your stopped services will be removed from the server within a day. Top up your wallet before then to keep their configs as they are.
retention.reactivated: ✅ Your service is active again. It reconnects within a few minutes — its link stays the same, so there is nothing to change in your app.
retention.reactivatedMany: ✅ {{count}} of your services are active again. They reconnect within a few minutes — their links stay the same.
retention.idle: 🔌 Your service has not been used for a week. If it stopped connecting: open My services, copy the subscription link again and update it in your VPN app — its servers may have changed. If you simply did not need it, there is nothing to do.
retention.idleMany: 🔌 {{count}} of your services have not been used for a week. If they stopped connecting: copy their subscription links again from My services and update them in your VPN app.
retention.runsOutSoonTitle: Your volume runs out in about {{days}} days
retention.runsOutSoon: 📉 At the rate you have used it over the last few days, the {{remaining}} left on your service runs out within {{days}} days. To keep it running without a break, renew it or add volume from My services.
retention.runsOutSoonMany: 📉 At your recent rate, {{count}} of your services run out of volume within a few days. See each one in My services and renew them to keep them running.
retention.runsOutWithinADayTitle: Your volume runs out within a day
retention.runsOutWithinADay: 📉 At the rate you have used it over the last few days, the {{remaining}} left on your service runs out within a day. Renew it or add volume now from My services so it does not stop.
retention.runsOutWithinADayMany: 📉 At your recent rate, {{count}} of your services run out of volume within a day. Renew them now from My services so they do not stop.
retention.runsOutWithinADayManyTitle: {{count}} services run out of volume within a day
retention.adminFrozen: ⏸️ Your service was paused by support. Its remaining time is kept: the days it stays paused are added back when it resumes.
retention.adminFrozenMany: ⏸️ {{count}} of your services were paused by support. Their remaining time is kept and added back when they resume.
retention.adminUnfrozen: ▶️ Your service was resumed by support and reconnects within a few minutes. The days it was paused were added to its end, and its link stays the same.
retention.adminUnfrozenMany: ▶️ {{count}} of your services were resumed by support. The days they were paused were added to their ends, and their links stay the same.
retention.adminDaysAdded: 📅 Support added {{days}} day(s) to your service. My services shows its new end date.
retention.adminDaysAddedMany: 📅 Support changed the time of {{count}} of your services. My services shows their new end dates.
retention.adminDaysRemoved: 📅 Support took {{days}} day(s) off your service. My services shows its new end date.
retention.adminDaysRemovedMany: 📅 Support changed the time of {{count}} of your services. My services shows their new end dates.
retention.adminTrafficAdded: 📶 Support added {{amount}} to your service's volume.
retention.adminTrafficAddedMany: 📶 Support changed the volume of {{count}} of your services. My services shows what each has left.
retention.adminTrafficRemoved: 📶 Support took {{amount}} off your service's volume. My services shows what is left.
retention.adminTrafficRemovedMany: 📶 Support changed the volume of {{count}} of your services. My services shows what each has left.
retention.adminTrafficReset: 🔄 Support reset your service's usage — its full volume is yours again.
retention.adminTrafficResetMany: 🔄 Support reset the usage of {{count}} of your services — their full volume is yours again.
retention.adminDeleted: 🗑️ Your service was deleted by support and no longer connects. If you think this is a mistake, contact support.
retention.adminDeletedMany: 🗑️ {{count}} of your services were deleted by support and no longer connect. If you think this is a mistake, contact support.
retention.adminLinkRotated: 🔗 Support changed your service's subscription link. The old link no longer works: copy the new one from My services and update it in your VPN app.
retention.adminLinkRotatedMany: 🔗 Support changed the subscription links of {{count}} of your services. The old links no longer work: copy the new ones from My services and update them in your VPN app.
retention.adminSpeedCappedTitle: Your service's speed was limited to {{mbps}} Mbps
retention.adminSpeedCapped: 🐢 Support limited your service's speed to {{mbps}} Mbps.
retention.adminSpeedCappedMany: 🐢 Support limited the speed of {{count}} of your services.
retention.adminSpeedUncappedTitle: Your service's speed limit was lifted
retention.adminSpeedUncapped: 🚀 Support lifted the speed limit on your service.
retention.adminSpeedUncappedMany: 🚀 Support lifted the speed limit on {{count}} of your services.
retention.adminDevicesLimitedTitle: Your service is limited to {{limit}} device(s)
retention.adminDevicesLimited: 📱 Support limited your service to {{limit}} device(s) at once. A device over the limit cannot connect until another disconnects.
retention.adminDevicesLimitedMany: 📱 Support limited how many devices can use {{count}} of your services at once.
retention.adminDevicesUnlimitedTitle: Your service's device limit was lifted
retention.adminDevicesUnlimited: 📱 Support lifted the device limit on your service.
retention.adminDevicesUnlimitedMany: 📱 Support lifted the device limit on {{count}} of your services.
retention.adminIssued: 🎁 Support gave you a new service. It is in My services, and its connection is ready within a few minutes.
retention.adminIssuedMany: 🎁 Support gave you {{count}} new services. They are in My services, and their connections are ready within a few minutes.
retention.adminRenewed: 🔁 Support renewed your service. My services shows its new end date and volume.
retention.adminRenewedMany: 🔁 Support renewed {{count}} of your services. My services shows their new end dates and volume.
retention.adminConfigRegeneratedTitle: A config of your service was rebuilt
retention.adminConfigRegenerated: 🔧 Support rebuilt one of your service's configs. If you added it to your app by hand, copy it again from My services; a subscription link updates on its own.
retention.adminConfigRegeneratedMany: 🔧 Support rebuilt {{count}} of your configs. If you added them to your app by hand, copy them again from My services; a subscription link updates on its own.
retention.adminConfigDisabledTitle: A config of your service was turned off
retention.adminConfigDisabled: ⏸️ Support turned off one of your service's configs; it no longer connects. Your other configs are unchanged.
retention.adminConfigDisabledMany: ⏸️ Support turned off {{count}} of your configs; they no longer connect.
retention.adminConfigEnabledTitle: A config of your service is back on
retention.adminConfigEnabled: ▶️ Support turned one of your service's configs back on; it connects again within a few minutes.
retention.adminConfigEnabledMany: ▶️ Support turned {{count}} of your configs back on; they connect again within a few minutes.
retention.adminConfigRetiredTitle: A config of your service was removed
retention.adminConfigRetired: 🗑️ Support removed one of your service's configs. My services shows the ones you still have.
retention.adminConfigRetiredMany: 🗑️ Support removed {{count}} of your configs. My services shows the ones you still have.
retention.adminConfigMovedTitle: A config of your service moved server
retention.adminConfigMoved: 🔀 Support moved one of your service's configs to another server. If you added it to your app by hand, copy it again from My services; a subscription link updates on its own.
retention.adminConfigMovedMany: 🔀 Support moved {{count}} of your configs to other servers. If you added them to your app by hand, copy them again from My services; a subscription link updates on its own.
retention.reactivatedLine: ✅ Your service is active again and reconnects within a few minutes — its link stays the same.
